# log.wz [![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/sravioli/log.wz?style=flat&label=Release&logo=github)](https://github.com/sravioli/log.wz/releases/latest)

**log.wz moved into [warp.wz](https://github.com/sravioli/warp.wz) as `warp.log`.**

This URL keeps working: it loads warp.wz and returns `warp.log`, the same table
every plugin uses. Switch to warp.wz when convenient:

```lua
local log = wezterm.plugin.require("https://github.com/sravioli/warp.wz").log
```

See the [warp.log guide](https://github.com/sravioli/warp.wz/blob/main/docs/log.md).
Report problems in [warp.wz issues](https://github.com/sravioli/warp.wz/issues).
